<entry id="E00747">
<head-word>הֲפֵכְתָּא, </head-word>
<head-word>הֲפֵי'</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (הֲפַךְ) 
<italic>destruction</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. 
<pgbrk id="pg362" />XIX, 29. Targ. O. Deut. XXIX, 20 (Ms. מַהֲפֶיכְתָּא); a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. הֲפֵיכָתָא</plural-form>.—Targ. Y. II Gen. XVIII, 2.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00748">
<head-word>הַפְלָאָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פָּלָא) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>distinction, peculiarity, use of the word</italic> פלא.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 138
<sup>b</sup> ה' זו וכ' this peculiarity of punishment (Deut. XXVIII, 59) &c.; ה' זו תורה it means the Law (afflictions causing the Law to be forgotten, ref. to Is. XXIX, 14).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>distinct and solemn specification of a vow</italic> (from Lev. XXVII, 2; Num. VI, 2; v. אִיסְפְּלִיאָה).</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Naz. III, 19 לא ניתנה נזירות אלא לה' the law of the 
<italic>nazir’s</italic> vow applies only to distinct utterance (where there is no doubt); Naz. 34
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.—Ib. 62
<sup>a</sup> of the two 
<italic>ki yafli</italic> (Lev. l. c. Num. l. c.) אחד ה' לאיסור ואחד ה' וכ' one intimates a distinct binding expression, and one a distinctness which opens the way to absolution (v. הֲָטָה); Ḥag. 10
<sup>a</sup> אחת ה' וכ'.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00749">
<head-word>הֶפְלֵג, </head-word>
<head-word>הֶפְלֵיג</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פָּלַג) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>separation, interruption, interval</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. B. Kam. II, end, 3
<sup>a</sup> בה' נגיחות it refers to gorings at intervals (not in three consecutive days). Y. Yoma III, 40
<sup>b</sup> bot. אם להפליג if the conversation lasted long enough to be considered a discontinuation of the services, opp. לשעה. Ib. עשו אותה כה' they declared it (the going out for easing one’s self, v. מסיכה) to be like a discontinuation.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>digression</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42
<sup>d</sup> bot. תשובת ה' השיבו he made a reply only to divert his mind (Bab. ib. 44
<sup>b</sup> תשובה גנובה, v. גָּנַב).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00752">
<head-word>הֶפְסֵד</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פסד) 
<italic>decrease, loss; injury; disadvantage; waste</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 15
<sup>b</sup> ה' חולין an unnecessary destruction of &c.—Ib., a. fr. ה' מרובה a considerable loss, opp. ה' מועט. Ab. II, 1 ה' מצוה the loss (inconvenience, sacrifice) connected with the performance of a good deed. Ib. V, 11, sq. וצא שכרו בהֶפְסֵדוֹ his advantage is set off by his disadvantage. Lev. R. s. 34 הֶפְסֵדָהּ the disadvantage of (punishment for) neglecting it, opp. שכרה reward for observing it. B. Kam. 115
<sup>b</sup> מפני ה' כהן because it is an injury to the priest (entitled to it). Sabb. 147
<sup>b</sup> ה' אוכלין a waste of eatables; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00754">
<head-word>הֶפְסֵק</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פסק) 
<italic>interruption, suspension, end</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 54
<sup>a</sup> און לו ה' וכ' there is no end to it for all eternity. Y. Ber. XI, 10
<sup>a</sup> bot. ה' ברכה an unlawful interruption between the blessing and the partaking of food. Ib. II, 5
<sup>b</sup> top ימי ה' intervening days during which menstruation ceased. Ib. IX, 13
<sup>c</sup> bot.; Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 32 ה' מלכות interregnum, anarchy. Y. Yeb. II, 3
<sup>d</sup> bot. שניות אין להן ה' the secondary degrees of forbidden marriages have no limitation; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00755">
<head-word>הַפְסָקָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>ceasing, interruption, interval</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 33 Sivan, the seventh month להַפְסָקַת וכ' counting from the time the rains ceased (Yalk. ib. 59 לירידת). Taan. 4
<sup>b</sup> לה' with reference to ceasing to insert the mention of rain in the prayers. Lev. R. s. 1, end אין כאן ה' there is nothing intervening (between ויקרא a. וידבר, Lev. I, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. הַפְסָקוֹת</plural-form>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 14, end ה' the intervals in revelations, i.e. passages in the Pentateuch not introduced by 
<italic>vayikra</italic> and 
<italic>vaydabber</italic>.—Esp. 
<italic>Hafsakah</italic>, the Sabbath intervening between the four Sabbaths on which the sections of the Torah, 
<italic>Sh’kalim, Zakhor, Parah</italic> and 
<italic>Ha</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>odesh</italic> are severally read, v. פָּרָשָׁה. Meg. 30
<sup>a</sup> שנייה לה' ‘the second Sabbath’ means that following the Hafsakah.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00759">
<head-word>הֶפְקֵר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (Y. dial. הֶבְקֵר)
<pos> m.</pos> (פָּקַר) 
<italic>declaring free, renunciation of ownership</italic> in favor of whosoever would take possession of the object renounced; 
<italic>confiscation; public property.</italic></definition>
<notes> Eduy. IV, 3 הפ' לעניים הפ' Ms. M. (ed. הב', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) renunciation of ownership (of the standing crop) in favor of the poor is valid (exempting from tithes); (oth. opin.) אינו ה' עד שיפקיר וכ' Ms. M. (ed. שיובקר) it is not valid unless the owner makes it free for the rich, too; Peah IV, 1 (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.); B. Mets. 30
<sup>b</sup> הפ'. Yeb. 89
<sup>b</sup>; Gitt. 36
<sup>b</sup> ה' ב"ד ה' the confiscation by the court (disposing of private property by the process of law) is valid; Y. Shek. I, 46
<sup>a</sup> bot. הב'. Peah I, 6 ונותן משום ה' or he may set aside a portion of his crop as public property. Y. ib. III, 17
<sup>c</sup> bot. וה' חייב בפיאה is public property ever subject to the laws of 
<italic>Peah?</italic> Ib. V, 19
<sup>b</sup> אין הֶבְקֵירוֹ ה' his renunciation is ineffectual. Ib. אין ה' יוצא … אלא בזכייה renounced property does not go out of the owner’s possession, until somebody takes possession of it; Y. Ned. IV, 38
<sup>d</sup> (corr. acc.). Y. Snh. VI, 23
<sup>b</sup>, beg. ה' טעות הוא it is a confiscation under an erroneous presumption (and invalid); a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 80, end בני אדם של ה' 
<italic>outlaws</italic>. Yeb. 66
<sup>a</sup> מנהג ה' נהגו בה people took liberties with her (because she had neither the legal status of a freed woman nor that of a slave).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00760">
<head-word>הֶפְקֵרָא, </head-word>
<head-word>הֶפְקֵירָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פקר, cmp. אַפְקָרוּתָא) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>unbridled lust, lawlessness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 13
<sup>a</sup> עבדא בה' ניחא ליה a slave prefers the dissolute life with a slave (to regular marriage with a free woman); Keth. 11
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> as preced. word. B. Kam. 115
<sup>b</sup> מה' קא זכינא (in securing the honey from a broken vessel on the road) I took possession of renounced goods.</definition>
<notes>—Targ. Y. Deut. XXV, 5 הֶפְקֵרָא (הֶפְקְרָא) 
<italic>an unprotected woman</italic></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00761">
<head-word>הָפֵר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (Inf. Hif. of פָּרַר, פּוּר; fr. Num. XXX, esp. verse 13) 
<italic>the law of ‘hafer’, the husband’s</italic> (or 
<italic>father’s</italic>) 
<italic>right</italic> of declaring void his wife’s (or 
<italic>daughter’s</italic>)
<italic> vow, invalidation</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ned. X, 7, a. fr. את שבא לכלל הקם בא לכלל ה' whatever comes under the law of 
<italic>hakem</italic> (confirmation), comes under the law of 
<italic>hafer</italic> (invalidation), i.e. as you 
<pgbrk id="pg363" />cannot confirm a vow before it has been made, so you cannot invalidate a vow in advance. Ib. 69
<sup>a</sup>; 79
<sup>a</sup> על הה' in a case where the right of invalidation might have been exercised. Tosef. ib. VII, 5 חומר בהקם שאינו בה' there are restrictions in the law of confirmation which do not apply to the law of invalidation &c. Y. ib. X, 42
<sup>a</sup> bot. ה' נדרים מעת לעת, v. next w.; a. fr. [In comment. our w. is spelled הפר and הֵיפֵר indiscriminately, which would intimate that it is pronounced הֵפֵר, fr. Num. XXX, 9.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00762">
<head-word>הֲפָרָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>invalidation, declaring void;</italic> also 
<italic>absolution for cause</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="E00957">הַתָּרָה</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Ned. X, 8 הֲפָרַת נדרים כל היום the right (of the father or the husband) to declare a vow void lasts the whole day on which it came to his notice (to sunset); Y. ib. 42
<sup>a</sup> bot. הפר נדרים מעת לעת twenty four hours; Tosef. ib. VI, 1; Sabb. 157
<sup>a</sup>.—Ned. 87
<sup>b</sup> מה הקמה ממנו אף ה' ממנו as the confirmation may be partial, so may the invalidation &c.; a. fr.—Gitt. 36
<sup>a</sup> אין לו ה' cannot be absolved from. Shebu. 29
<sup>b</sup> top כי היכי … ה' in order to make absolution impossible.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00765">

<entry id="E00775">
<head-word>הֶפְתֵּק</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פתק 
<italic>to cut, divide off;</italic> Var. lect.</definition>
<notes> v. infra) 
<italic>the store-room</italic> in the dwelling house out of which the daily portions of provision and work are distributed; also 
<italic>the retailer’s shelves</italic> &c., contrad. to אוצר ware-house. Ab. Zar. II, 7 (39
<sup>b</sup>) הבאין מן הה' the preserved locusts which the merchant takes from the shelves, contrad. to מן הסלולה, those laid out in baskets in front of the counter. Ib. 40
<sup>b</sup> מן הה' מן האוצר ומן הספינה (not הסלולה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5); Tosef. ib. IV (V), 12 מן הפתק וכ' ed. Zuck. (Var. הפתיק, cmp. הֶמְסֵס for fusion of article) from the shelves, the ware-room or the ship.—Sabb. 50
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. III (IV), 19 גיזי צמר של ה' cut wool stored in the pantry (intended for spinning; Rashi: from the merchant’s shelves). [Ar. s. v. אפתק reads: אוּפְתֵּק, noting a Var. ה'. One Ms. Ar., a. Mish. ed. Nap. read אפותיק for אוּפְתֵּיק, induced by phonetic resemblance to ἀποθήκη. V. Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. אפתק, a. Rabb. D. S. to Ab. Zar. 39
<sup>b</sup> note 8.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>there</italic> refers to a sacrifice which has an atoning effect; a. fr.</notes></sense>

<number>—3)</number>

<italic>so now!, indeed</italic>, i.e. 
<italic>how can you compare these two cases?</italic> Snh. 41
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—2) (introducing an argument) 
<italic>since, when</italic>
<italic>, if</italic>. Ḥull. 5
